    Applications are now open for vacancies on the Te Rōpū Kaiārahi Hauātanga, the Ombudsman’s Disability Advisory Panel. Te Rōpū Kaiārahi Hauātanga Panel plays an important role in providing lived experience and professional disability right advice, insight and guidance to support the Ombudsman Office’s work. Panel members contribute their knowledge, perspectives, and expertise to help ensure our work remains grounded in the communities we work with. We are seeking people who are passionate about contributing their lived experience to influence meaningful change.. If this sounds like you, we would love for you to apply. You can find the application details here: https://lnkd.in/eHzVhPiA We’ve also made information available in New Zealand Sign Language (NZSL) and alternative formats here: https://lnkd.in/erCdChxp Please contact us to get the job description and advert in Braille. Applications close on: 11th May 2026

    ‼️ New opportunities ‼️ We are currently on the lookout for a strong leader to join us as our Assistant Ombudsman, Investigations! We have just completed an organisational transformation, and we are evolving how we do our mahi to have greater impact. This is a new way of working where kaimahi are genuinely empowered, collaboration is real, leadership is visible and values-driven, and where the people doing the work can see their input shaping the direction of the organisation. This is a crucial role supporting the Investigations group. It is about enabling performance through others; giving your managers the direction, support and space to lead well. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy on case strategy, delivery and resource allocation, while working as a genuine peer across the Senior Leadership Team to ensure the whole Office moves forward together. Interested? Learn more here 👇 https://lnkd.in/ebKXct5V

    Assistant Ombudsman, Investigations | Wellington careers.ombudsman.parliament.nz

    🌺 Senior Advisor, Systemic Improvement Monitoring and Resolution 🌺 We are currently on the look out for a Senior Advisor to join our SIMR team to provide advice on identified trends and opportunities for systemic improvement via internal and external monitoring. The team develops and maintains robust systems to identify issues, assess options for intervention, and seek resolution where possible to contribute to meaningful change in public sector administration. Are you: ✨ A critical thinker with analytical rigour who can see things from a range of perspectives? ✨ Have a highly developed and detailed understanding of, and have practical experience in, strategic policy advice, analysis, review, development and implementation? ✨ Highly resilient and able to work with sensitive material? Join us! Check out the job description and read more here 👉 https://lnkd.in/gkMrKeqr
